description: Save an attachment (from homework, assignments, schedule, study material or messages) to the download folder. Pass the attachment's fileUrl as url, or its bestanddataId (files without a fileUrl; a signed link is requested from Somtoday with your session). Returns savedPath (folder: SOMTODAY_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads/somtoday-mcp), size, type and fileName — no text extraction. Max 10 MB; fileUrl only from https Somtoday hosts (extend with SOMTODAY_MCP_ATTACHMENT_HOSTS); no token is sent to file hosts.

bestanddataId.description: bestanddataId of an attachment (used when it has no fileUrl, or the fileUrl host is not allowed).

fileName.description: Name for the saved file when the server sends none (e.g. the attachment's fileName).

save.description: Save a copy to disk (default true).

url.description: fileUrl of an attachment from homework, assignments, schedule, study_material or messages.

name: download_attachment
title: Download attachment
